versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei抖音趋势信号探测器:

- Provides structured JSON data for Douyin keyword search, post fetching, video comment extraction, and real-time trending topics.
- Covers typical user intents such as content research, competitor analysis, and hot trend tracking, triggered by natural language queries.
- Enforces strict token management and error-handling protocols; only public Douyin data, no promotion or cross-platform support.
- Commands run under Node.js, configured via environment variable; outputs and logs are standardized.
- Supports multi-step workflows and parameter inference based on user phrasing.
